observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: spaceship interior, crew, mission control and exterior space shots.
On-screen information appears on props in the scene ('OFF COURSE' console, phone showing 'No GPS Signal', 'NO FLUSHING TONIGHT' sign).
Interior character shots alternate with wide exterior shots of the ship among stars.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Ends on a calm payoff line about navigating home by the stars.
Hook is a single concrete paradox stated immediately: "If you flush the toilet on a spaceship, you'll never make it back to Earth."
Ends on a concrete payoff that resolves the hook, no call to action: "And because there's no GPS out here, the only way to find home is by lining up the real stars."

categorical.hook_style: one-sentence concrete paradox (strange action, absurd consequence, or rule + contradiction), no intro
categorical.ending_style: concrete payoff image that resolves the hook, then the video stops (no CTA, no summary)
